intent: The durable in-app inbox of product notifications: an sm bell with the unread count opens a 24rem kit Popover (a full-height Drawer below --grid-breakpoint-sm) with the list, Mark all read and View all. Toasts stay for instant feedback; agent approvals live in AgentInbox.
useWhen: show payments, sign-ins and billing updates people can read later
an app header needs a bell with an unread count
a settings or activity page shows the same list in place (inline)
doNotUseWhen: instant feedback for an action just taken — Toast

items.note: { id, title, body?, createdAt, read, tone?: 'neutral'|'success'|'info'|'warning'|'danger', icon?, group?, action?: { label, onClick } }[]. group ("Today", "Yesterday") gathers items under a heading; action is one outline sm Button, only when the event needs a decision. createdAt shows in mono.

inline.note: Render the panel in place, with no bell or popover.

onMarkRead.note: Called when an unread item is opened.

requirements: the bell is an sm kit Button named "Notifications, 3 unread"; the count chip is aria-hidden
the panel is the kit Popover dialog, named by label; Escape closes and returns focus to the bell. Below --grid-breakpoint-sm it is a kit Drawer with the same rows
unread is a filled rail marker plus a New badge, never colour or weight alone; each row reads "New. Payment failed. … 09:42." and the marker is aria-hidden
Mark all read is announced in a polite status region and focus stays on it
new items fade and drop in on transform and opacity, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local NotificationBell or NotificationList
Do not restyle Toast as an inbox
Do not show unread by colour or bold alone: keep the marker and the New badge
Do not style Mark all read or View all as text links: they are ghost and outline sm Buttons
Do not route agent approvals here — AgentInbox
